Thanks, Rafael. Quick checklist for onboarding ToraTek (please forward this to Engin):

Required for vendor setup and PO activation:
- Legal entity name and registered address exactly as on tax certificate.
- Turkish VKN (tax ID) and a copy of the tax registration certificate (PDF).
- Company registration number (if different).
- EFT/IBAN (preferred) and SWIFT/BIC for wire. If invoicing in USD, provide intermediary correspondent bank details if applicable.
- Payment terms (Net 30 by default) and preferred currency.
- Primary AP contact (name/email) — accounts@toratek.com is fine but we prefer a named contact for escalations.

Invoice format and e-invoice specifics:
- If you can supply e-Fatura XML (UBL-like) include the PO number in the <Reference> or <OrderReference> field. We store the XML in our AP system for automated matching.
- If you cannot supply e-invoice, a PDF with the fields above plus a line-level tax breakdown is acceptable.
- For services supplied from Turkey to a US customer: we need the vendor to confirm whether Turkish VAT was charged or if the invoice is issued VAT-exempt under any applicable export rule. If VAT was charged and Redwood is not VAT-registered in TR, we will need to evaluate recoverability.

Optional but helpful:
- A signed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached) with W-8 equivalent question filled out. Note: we do not collect US W-8 forms for Turkish vendors unless there is US-sourced income; still helpful to indicate tax residency.
- A sample e-invoice XML so our integration team can validate the tags (attach to the Drive link).

I'll attach the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf to this thread for Engin to fill and return. Once we have the documents we can complete vendor setup and confirm PO payment routing.

Ben Carter
Accounts Payable Manager, Redwood Inference
